title: TCP Read
text: Receive TCP/IP packets from remote host over TCP/IP network, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of TCP/IP packets received; {Network role} sets the block as client, {Remote address} sets the iP address of remote server from which TCP/IP packets are received, {Remote port} sets the iP port on remote server from which TCP/IP packets are, {Local port} sets the iP port of host on which data is received, {Maximum data length (elements)} sets the maximum length of output TCP/IP packet, {Enable event-based execution} enables event-based task execution and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: Stream of TCP/IP packets received from the remote host scalar

ports.name: data
ports.summary: TCP/IP packet received from remote host numeric vector

ports.name: length
ports.summary: Length of output TCP/IP packet nonnegative scalar

params.name: Network role
params.values: Set block as client or server Client (default) | Server

params.name: Remote address
params.values: IP address of remote server from which TCP/IP packets are received 127.0.0.1 (default) | dotted-quad expression

params.name: Remote port
params.values: IP port on remote server from which TCP/IP packets are received 25000 (default) | integer from 1 to 65535

params.name: Local port
params.values: IP port of host on which data is received -1 (default) | integer from 1 to 65,535

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of TCP/IP packets received uint8 (default) | single | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint16 | uint32

params.name: Maximum data length (elements)
params.values: Maximum length of output TCP/IP packet 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Enable event-based execution
params.values: Enable event-based task execution off (default) | on
